style: A single game prop, centered, on a plain flat light-grey background, nothing else in frame. Three-quarter view from slightly above (about 25 degrees), full object visible with space around it. Hand-painted dark-fantasy style, muted desaturated palette, soft even lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no text, no characters. Chunky readable silhouette, detailed surface texture, suitable for 3D reconstruction.

prompts.caves_crystal_cluster: A tall cluster of five to seven glowing cyan crystals growing from a small base of dark blue-grey rock. One large central crystal with smaller ones leaning outward. The facets are translucent and glow softly from inside.
prompts.caves_stalagmite: A tall pointed stalagmite spire of layered dark blue-grey rock with faint strata. Two smaller spires at its base. Wet, slightly glossy surface and a few tiny violet crystal flecks.
prompts.caves_rockpile: A low pile of three or four rounded dark blue-grey boulders. Thin glowing cyan and violet crystal veins run through the cracks.
prompts.caves_floor_crystal: A small cluster of three short violet crystals on a flat stone chip. It should read from far away and glow.
prompts.caves_wall_chunk: A wide, tall chunk of jagged cave wall rock. Dark blue-grey, with several crystal outcrops along the top edge.
prompts.hollow_swamp_tree: A gnarled dead swamp tree with a twisted trunk, exposed roots flaring at the base, and a few bare crooked branches. Long strands of hanging moss drip from the branches. Dark grey-brown bark, murky green moss.
prompts.hollow_stump: A rotted, hollow tree stump with a mossy top and roots splaying into the ground. A few small purple toadstools grow on its side.
prompts.hollow_bog_rock: A low group of two or three dark boulders thickly covered in wet green moss, with a few vines.
prompts.hollow_wisp_plant: A small swamp plant with curled stems and a faintly glowing green orb at the tip.
prompts.academy_candelabra: A short brass candelabra with three lit candles, wax dripping down. Warm and glowing.
prompts.academy_wall_bookcase: A wide, low row of two bookcases pushed together, packed with tomes. Dark wood and purple cloth spines.
